title: Explanted Lung Tissues With Pulmonary Fibrosis
official: Utilization of Explanted Lungs for Isolation of Tissue Samples and Primary Cell Lines to Study Pulmonary Fibrosis
summary: The goal of this study is to use the tissues from the explanted lungs in order to better study the cause of pulmonary fibrosis at a cellular level.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all patients awaiting lung transplant

Exclusion Criteria:

* all who will not give consent
